title: Cups, generous budget
story: Learned to drink from ponds inside wall rings (cups) when the energy budget is generous (loss 0.75), with the pond curriculum.

title: Never discovered drinking
story: Trained on cups from generation 1 with no curriculum. This seed never found the ponds worth visiting and sits on the food until thirst kills it.

title: Cups without any curriculum
story: Same training as the stuck one, different seed: this one stumbled on drinking early and then learned cups as well as the curriculum runs.

title: Tight budget: cups barely pay
story: Trained and tested at energy loss 1.25: a trip into a cup costs about as much as the energy store holds, so almost nothing drinks on cups.

title: Short sight, loss 1.0
story: Sight 5 and no occlusion at energy loss 1.0: the dots see little of the rings and about a quarter get into a cup.
